params.name: user
params.description: User ID to filter timesheets. Needs permission 'view_other_timesheet', pass 'all' to fetch data for all user (default: current user)

params.name: users[]
params.description: List of user IDs to filter, e.g.: users[]=1&users[]=2 (ignored if user=all)

params.name: customer
params.description: Customer ID to filter timesheets

params.name: customers[]
params.description: List of customer IDs to filter, e.g.: customers[]=1&customers[]=2

params.name: project
params.description: Project ID to filter timesheets

params.name: projects[]
params.description: List of project IDs to filter, e.g.: projects[]=1&projects[]=2

params.name: activity
params.description: Activity ID to filter timesheets

params.name: activities[]
params.description: List of activity IDs to filter, e.g.: activities[]=1&activities[]=2

params.name: page
params.description: The page to display, renders a 404 if not found (default: 1)

params.name: size
params.description: The amount of entries for each page (default: 50, max: 500)

params.name: tags[]
params.description: List of tag names, e.g. tags[]=bar&tags[]=foo

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, begin, end, rate (default: begin)

params.name: order
params.description: The result order. Allowed values: ASC, DESC (default: DESC)

params.name: begin
params.description: Only records started at or after this date-time will be included (format: HTML5 datetime-local, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: end
params.description: Only records started at or before this date-time will be included (format: HTML5 datetime-local, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: exported
params.description: Use this flag if you want to filter for export state. Allowed values: 0=not exported, 1=exported (default: all)

params.name: active
params.description: Filter for running/active records. Allowed values: 0=stopped, 1=active (default: all)

params.name: billable
params.description: Filter for non-/billable records. Allowed values: 0=non-billable, 1=billable (default: all)

params.name: full
params.description: Allows to fetch full objects including subresources. Allowed values: 0|1|false|true (default: false)

params.name: term
params.description: Free search term

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Only records changed after this date will be included. You need to pass in a UTC date-time, as this field is stored in UTC (format: HTML5 datetime-local, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

200.description: Returns a collection of timesheets. The datetime fields are given in the users local time including the timezone offset (ISO-8601).
